title: Add live QR ride queue and silent driver decline
target: Hoy Driver Inbox + standalone request app
acceptanceCriteria: Decline completes inside Hoy Driver Inbox without navigating the driver away.
Repeated accept or decline actions are idempotent and one tap produces one authoritative action.
The rider receives at most one decline email from the standalone request app.
The QR form supports typed pickup, optional explicit browser location, required destination, and NOW or LATER timing.
QR_LIVE requests are limited to today in America/New_York and remain distinct from scheduled/private form rides.
A valid QR_LIVE request creates exactly one REQUESTED row through the existing standalone request app.
LATER requests appear in Hoy Driver Inbox and send one driver email.
Accept preserves the existing request row and enters the existing Scheduled/active lifecycle without creating a duplicate reservation or trip.
Unresolved LATER requests auto-decline 30 minutes before pickup through a request-app-owned trigger.
Scheduled-form rides are excluded from QR_LIVE expiry processing.
NOW response-window behavior is configurable through Script Properties and is not permanently hard-coded.
No fare, payment, automatic dispatch, background location, direct Hoy Driver Ride Requests write, production deployment, or production mutation is introduced.
Phone validation and Pulse Forge CI pass before merge.
